title: 30A East Playa Maya Carriage House Inlet Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Charming Carriage House!* Steps from Rosemary Beach-4 Minute Walk to the Beach * 2 Complimentary Bikes * Across from Rosemary Beach Racquet...
description_expanded: OverviewTop Reasons to Book this Charming Carriage House!* Steps from Rosemary Beach-4 Minute Walk to the Beach * 2 Complimentary Bikes * Across from Rosemary Beach Racquet Club and Walk to 30Avenue – Convenient location for tennis, shops, restaurants and recreation* Playa Maya Main House Add Optional-For larger groups, the Playa Maya Main and Carriage House can be rented together. The Playa Maya Main home, can provide additional accommodations and flexibility when available.* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service* This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. ** Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.*Welcome to Playa Maya Carriage House, a cozy stand-alone retreat in beautiful Inlet Beach! Located just steps from Rosemary Beach and directly across from the Rosemary Beach Racquet Club, this charming one-bedroom getaway is perfect for couples or solo travelers looking for a comfortable and convenient 30A escape. Inside, the Carriage House offers a comfortable studio-style living space with a Queen bed, full bathroom with walk-in shower, and flat-screen TV. The fully equipped kitchen includes a stove, oven, small dishwasher, microwave, and refrigerator (no freezer), giving you everything you need to prepare simple meals during your stay. Whether you're planning a romantic getaway, solo beach escape, or simply want a cozy home base in the heart of 30A, Playa Maya Carriage House offers comfort, charm, and an excellent location.The Bed Setup:Bedroom: Queen BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
